name: t
note: board overall thickness, copper included (1 mm stock: measure yours)

name: S
note: dipole axis -> face outer copper (the sweep's best spacing)

name: L
note: dipole length tip to tip (along v), tuned 2026-11-23

name: g
note: slot gap between the strips (2 mm: less sensitive to hand-cut error)

name: Ws
note: strip width (along v), each side of the slot

name: Wf
note: feed line width (50 ohm on 0.93 mm FR-4)

name: u0
note: feed line start, clear of the face (coax solders here)

name: uc
note: crossing: centre of the feed's vertical leg (u)

name: Lsh
note: stub's leg back toward the face, from the crossing leg's face-side edge

name: m
note: bare board past the copper (outline margin)

name: slot_w
note: face slot width for the 1 mm board

name: etch
note: tolerance runs only: every copper edge moved out by this (negative = over-cut)
